fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in the town centre. Everything is walkable, from Main Beach and the health-focused cafe scene to the start of the Cape Byron lighthouse walk.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Gold Coast Airport to Byron Bay Bus
fieldData.city-description:
Byron Bay, the laid-back coastal town on the far north coast of New South Wales, draws visitors with its golden beaches, surf culture and relaxed, bohemian spirit. Walk up to the Cape Byron Lighthouse on mainland Australia's most easterly point.

‍

For vegan travellers, Byron Bay is a small town with plenty of delicious options. Treat yourself to an all-vegan dinner and one of the best tiramisus around at No Bones, or cool off with a scoop of matcha macadamia gelato from Frankies. The town's health-conscious vibe means vegan food is never far away.
fieldData.name: Byron Bay

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in Phuket Old Town for the island's best vegan food scene, colourful streets and, during the Vegetarian Festival, the centre of the action. Add a few nights on the coast if you want beach time.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Phuket Airport to Old Town: private transfer
fieldData.city-description: While famous for its stunning beaches and turquoise waters, the island of Phuket is a destination for vegan foodies best known for hosting the world's most impressive vegan food celebration, the Phuket Vegetarian Festival. Beyond this incredible event, you'll find a thriving year-round scene, including high-quality international restaurants like Ubuntu Eat, or a luxurious plant-based resort like Soul Villa.
fieldData.name: Phuket

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in the Old City or Nimman. The Old City puts you among the temples and the Sunday Walking Street, while Nimman has a trendy cafe scene, and both have plenty of vegan food nearby.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Bangkok to Chiang Mai: domestic flights
fieldData.experience-label: Doi Inthanon National Park day trip

destination-gallery.alt: River around Chiang Mai's Old Town

fieldData.city-description: Nestled in the mountains of Northern Thailand, Chiang Mai is the creative heart of the country's vegan scene. Its relaxing atmosphere is home to a thriving plant-based community, with incredible food found everywhere from the charming laneways of Old Town to the trendy Nimman neighbourhood. You can indulge in comforting pizzas at places like Rad Rabbit, make a special trip for a top-tier cafe at Vegano Bistro, or stay at an all-vegan hotel at Away Chiang Mai.
fieldData.name: Chiang Mai

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in Sukhumvit around Asok or near Siam. Both are on the BTS Skytrain with plenty of vegan food nearby, making it easy to reach the temples, malls and markets.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Suvarnabhumi Airport to city: private transfer
fieldData.experience-label: Bangkok temple tour with Grand Palace, Wat Pho and more
fieldData.city-description:
Bangkok is a sprawling metropolis where the vegan food scene is as diverse as the city itself, offering everything from high-end Thai classics to creative cafes. The vibrant Sukhumvit area is packed with stylish spots like Golden State Sushi and Vistro, while near the Grand Palace, you can refuel at local gems like Veganerie and Kem-Kon after exploring the temples.

‍
fieldData.name: Bangkok

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in Tsim Sha Tsui or around Central and Sheung Wan. Both have plenty of vegan and vegetarian food nearby, with the Star Ferry and MTR linking you to the rest of the city.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Airport to city: Airport Express ticket
fieldData.experience-label: Ngong Ping 360 cable car to the Big Buddha
fieldData.city-description:
Hong Kong, an energetic city where East truly meets West, amazes with its bright skyline and non-stop energy. From the busy street markets to the peaceful views from Victoria Peak, this city offers a captivating blend of tradition and modern life, set against the stunning background of Victoria Harbour.

‍

For vegan adventurers, you'll be happy to hear that Hong Kong has some amazing vegan options. Experience traditional Cantonese flavours with delicious vegan dim sum at Veggie Kingdom, try out a vegan take on the popular egg waffle from LN Coffee, or stroll along bustling shopping centres with a bubble tea from Mother Pearl.
fieldData.name: Hong Kong

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Kamakura is an easy day trip from Tokyo. To stay overnight, choose the area around Kamakura Station, next to the food stalls of Komachi-dori and a short walk from Tsurugaoka Hachimangu.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Day trip from Tokyo to Kamakura
fieldData.experience-label: Kamakura guided day tour from Tokyo
fieldData.city-description:
Kamakura is a popular seaside city about an hour from Tokyo, making it a convenient day trip destination for vegans. The main tourist draws are the impressive Tsurugaoka Hachimangu shrine and the giant Buddha statue in Kotoku-in. However, it's worth venturing beyond the crowded sights to explore Kamakura's quieter areas. Don't miss out on the amazing vegan food in this city like the colourful sushi plates from Chirashiya, the tasty dorayaki
from Cafe Stand Blossom Kamakura, and the epic vegan burgers at Luna Burger. While Kamakura can feel touristy at times, this city is still well
worth visiting for its unique charm and excellent vegan food.

‍
fieldData.name: Kamakura

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Himeji is an easy day trip from Osaka or Kyoto by Shinkansen. If you stay overnight, the area around Himeji Station puts you on the main street leading straight to Himeji Castle.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Shinkansen to Himeji: JR Kansai Wide Area Pass
fieldData.experience-label: Himeji Castle day tour from Osaka
fieldData.city-description:
Himeji is a beautiful, historic city not too far from Osaka and Kyoto, making it a great day trip idea for those who want to be immersed in Japan's rich history and culture. The city’s crown jewel is Himeji Castle, one of Japan's best preserved old castles. Also known as the "White Heron Castle”, visiting is a must to see its elegant, white appearance. Even though Himeji has lots of traditional sights, it also has some surprisingly amazing vegan restaurants like Sai Cafe and il riccio. With its unforgettable blend of history, beautiful gardens and delicious vegan food, Himeji is a great city to slow down, relax and savour the charms of this cultural gem.

‍
fieldData.name: Himeji

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Kobe is an easy day trip from Osaka or Kyoto. To stay overnight, pick the area around Sannomiya Station, Kobe's main hub, within walking distance of Kitano, Chinatown and the harbourfront.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Osaka Kansai Airport to Kobe Station
fieldData.city-description:
Kobe is a lively port city located conveniently close to Osaka, about a 40-minute train ride away without needing to take the Shinkansen bullet train. Despite its compact size, this little city packs in plenty of attractions, like iconic Kobe Port Tower, the Harborland shopping district and the beautiful Ikuta Shrine. Kobe also has a handful of quality vegan restaurants like Vegan Cafe Kiu and Vegan Cafe Thallo, where you can enjoy tasty vegan lunch plates with a variety of small dishes. All of that makes Kobe an excellent day trip from Osaka or Kyoto.

‍
fieldData.name: Kobe

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in Namba or Shinsaibashi. You'll be within walking distance of Dotonbori and plenty of vegan options, with direct trains to Kansai Airport and Nara.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Kansai Airport to Namba: Nankai Rapi:t
fieldData.city-description:
Osaka is a vibrant and lively city that promises an unforgettable experience for vegan travellers. From the iconic Osaka Castle to the bustling Dotonbori district, this city has a lot for you to explore and experience. The friendly locals and their love for good food will make you feel welcomed.

‍

Osaka is often refers to as the “Kitchen of Japan”, and that applies to vegan food as well. Vegan foodies will be delighted by the diverse plant-based offerings in Osaka. Vegancafe Sister is a must-visit for those with a sweet tooth. Or try the realistic and nostalgic egg sandwich from Mercy Vegan Factory. Browse our Osaka foodie guides for all the delicious food spots.
fieldData.name: Osaka

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in the CBD or Surry Hills to be close to the harbour, the Opera House and ferries. Surry Hills and nearby Newtown are also home to many of Sydney's best vegan restaurants.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Sydney Airport to city: shuttle transfer

destination-gallery.alt: Art Gallery of New South Wales

fieldData.city-description:
Sydney, Australia's amazing harbour city, instantly impresses with its famous landmarks like the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge. From the busy city centre to the popular shores of Bondi Beach, Sydney offers a stunning mix of natural beauty and big-city style.

‍

The vegan food scene in Sydney is equally lively and exciting. Grab a slice of authentic Neapolitan-style pizza from Gigi Pizzeria, or dive into creative, modern Mexican flavours at Vandal Taqueria or Calle Rey. Sydney serves up world-class vegan dining with style.
fieldData.name: Sydney

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in the CBD. It's compact and walkable, with plenty of vegan options in the East End and around Chinatown, and it's the easiest base for day trips to the Barossa and Adelaide Hills.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Adelaide Airport to city bus service
fieldData.name: Adelaide

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in the CBD for easy tram access almost everywhere, or in Fitzroy or Collingwood to be close to one of Melbourne's biggest clusters of vegan cafes and bars.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Melbourne Airport to city: SkyBus
fieldData.city-description:
Wander through its many laneways decorated with bright street art, or sip an oat flat white at a trendy coffee shop, Melbourne is a city buzzing with creative energy and hidden gems waiting around every corner.

‍

As a great spot for foodies, Melbourne boasts an incredible and well-known vegan scene. Indulge in a truly authentic Italian feast at Funghi e Tartufo, or grab some iconic, must-try fresh pastries and deli goods from the famous Smith & Deli. Melbourne's plant-based scene won't disappoint.
fieldData.name: Melbourne

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in Surfers Paradise or Broadbeach. Both are right on the beach and the G:link tram line, with plenty of places to eat nearby and good transport to the theme parks.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Gold Coast Airport to your hotel: shared transfer
fieldData.city-description:
The Gold Coast, famous for its sun-kissed beaches and sparkling coastline, is a playground of sun, surf, and fun. Beyond the well-known Surfers Paradise and exciting theme parks, discover the beautiful greenery of the nearby hinterland. It's a destination that radiates energy and cool coastal vibes.

‍

Vegan food lovers will find exciting options here too, blending health-consciousness with flavour. Start your day with a beautiful, art-like acai bowl from Cardamom Pod, or treat yourself to authentic and satisfying vegan yum cha at Easy House.
fieldData.name: Gold Coast

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay near Nagoya Station for easy Shinkansen day trips, or in Sakae, the city's dining and shopping centre, close to the cafes of Osu and a short ride from Nagoya Castle.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Tokyo to Nagoya: Shinkansen tickets
fieldData.name: Nagoya

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in Tenjin for the city's best dining and shopping, within walking distance of the riverside yatai stalls in Nakasu. Hakata Station is the better pick if you're taking the Shinkansen.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Exploring Kyushu: JR Kyushu Rail Pass
fieldData.experience-label: Day trip to Yufuin, Dazaifu and more
fieldData.name: Fukuoka

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in Naha near Kokusai-dori for the widest choice of food and easy monorail access to the airport. If you're hiring a car to explore the island, add a few nights further north near the beaches.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Explore the island: Okinawa car rental
fieldData.name: Okinawa

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay near Formosa Boulevard or Central Park MRT stations. You'll be right on the MRT, close to night markets with vegetarian stalls, and a short ride from the Pier-2 Art Center.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Taipei to Kaohsiung: High Speed Rail ticket
fieldData.experience-label: Kaohsiung Full-Day Cultural & Art Discovery Tour
fieldData.name: Kaohsiung

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Most visitors see Nara on a day trip from Osaka or Kyoto. If you stay overnight, choose the area around Kintetsu-Nara Station, a short walk from Nara Park, the old streets of Naramachi and the city's vegan-friendly cafes.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Osaka to Nara: Kintetsu Rail Pass
fieldData.city-description: Nara is a historic city that you can visit from Osaka or Kyoto in under an hour. Its top attraction is Nara Park, where hundreds of friendly, bowing deer roam freely. You can get up close with these cute animals while exploring the park's beautiful scenery. Another must-see is the impressive Todai-ji Temple with its giant Buddha statue. The city also has a surprising number of great vegan food options like the vibrant lunch plates at Onwa, the tasty red bean mochi from Nakatanidou, and vegan black sesame ice cream sold right in Nara Park - the perfect treat to enjoy while watching the deer. Although this city can get quite crowded, it's well worth a visit.
fieldData.name: Nara

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay downtown around Shijo-Kawaramachi. It's walkable to Gion and Nishiki Market, close to many of Kyoto's vegan cafes, and well connected by bus and train to the main temples.
fieldData.getting-around-label: JR West Kansai Area Pass
fieldData.experience-label: Kyoto the art of kintsugi workshop
fieldData.city-description:
One of my favourite cities, Kyoto offers a harmonious blend of cultural richness and delectable vegan cuisines. Immerse yourself in the serenity of the golden Kinkaku-ji Temple, marvel at the stunning torii gates of Fushimi Inari Taisha, or stroll through the bamboo forest in Arashiyama.

‍

When it comes to food, vegan foodies will be glad to know that there are gems waiting to be discovered throughout the city. Enjoy the lunch plate from Mumokuteki Cafe which comes with a dazzling selection of small dishes, or try out the viral ‘flower bouquet’ ice cream from (Thisis)Nature.
fieldData.name: Kyoto

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in Hongdae or Itaewon for the best concentration of vegan-friendly cafes and restaurants, or Myeongdong if you'd rather be central for shopping and the palaces.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Incheon Airport to Seoul Station: AREX Express
fieldData.name: Seoul

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay around Bugis or Chinatown. Both are central and well connected by MRT, with hawker centres nearby where vegetarian stalls are easy to find.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Changi Airport to city: bus transfer
fieldData.name: Singapore

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay near Taipei Main Station or Ximending. The station has direct trains to the airport and the high-speed rail, and Ximending, one MRT stop away, is a lively area packed with vegetarian food.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Taiwan Easycard transport card
fieldData.city-description:
Taipei is an exciting destination for vegan foodies. Not only is it a bustling city that offers a great blend of tradition with modernity, you can also find some of the best vegan food here in Taipei. Indulge in exquisite, creative dishes from classy restaurants like Foldie and Vegan Amore, or enjoy irresistible street food like dumplings and stinky tofu, Taipei has so much to offer in terms of excellent vegan food. In this section, let me take you through all the best vegan options in this vibrant city.

‍
fieldData.name: Taipei

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Base yourself in Shibuya or Shinjuku. Both are major train hubs close to Harajuku and Omotesando, where many of Tokyo's best vegan cafes are, and well connected to sights across the city.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Unlimited metro rides: Tokyo Subway Ticket

destination-gallery.alt: Night View from Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building

fieldData.city-description:
Tokyo, the pulsating heart of Japan, is a city that offers both rich Japanese culture and modern innovations. From the neon-lit streets of Kabukicho and iconic landmarks like the Sensoji Temple and the Tokyo Tower, Tokyo captivates travellers with its energy and contrasts.  

‍

For vegan foodies, Tokyo is an unexpected vegan food heaven. You can expect to find a dazzling array of vegan options in Tokyo, including the authentic, ultra-umami ramen from Vegan Bistro Jangara, realistic and meaty karaage from Izakaya Masaka, and the trendy whipped cream fruit sandwich from Fruits and Season.
fieldData.name: Tokyo

fieldData.where-to-stay-tip: Stay in South Brisbane or West End. You'll be close to South Bank Parklands and the Cultural Centre, near one of Brisbane's best clusters of vegan cafes, and a short walk or bus ride from the CBD.
fieldData.getting-around-label: Brisbane Airport to city: Airtrain
fieldData.city-description:
Brisbane, the sunny capital of Queensland, welcomes visitors with its laid-back charm and lively riverside energy. Explore the green South Bank Parklands, stroll along the Brisbane River, or take in the views from the Story Bridge. This city blends city style with a relaxed outdoor lifestyle.

‍

For vegan travellers, Brisbane offers some wonderful food surprises waiting to be discovered. Indulge in comforting Thai-fusion comfort food from Vega Cafe, or slurp down a satisfyingly warm bowl of ramen from Neon Ramen. The city's growing vegan scene is ready to be explored.
fieldData.name: Brisbane
